in_sanskrit.name: Chhavi
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शिखण्डी (Shikhandini) - A female name mentioned in the Mahabharata.

in_hindi.name: चहवी
in_hindi.long_meaning: चहवी (Cahvī) - Hides power or energy. A modern name derived from the Sanskrit word चहना (chhanā) meaning 'to hide'. The name is also derived from the name of Shikhandini, a female character in the Mahabharata.

in_tamil.name: சஹவீ
in_tamil.long_meaning: சஹவீ (Cahvī) - New power. A Tamil name derived from the Sanskrit word சிகம் (sigam) meaning 'power'. The name is also derived from the name of Shikhandini, a female character in the Mahabharata.

in_telugu.name: చేవీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: చేవీ (Cevī) - One who hides or conceals. A Telugu name derived from the Sanskrit word చేశ్చే (cheshchē) meaning 'to hide'. The name is also derived from the name of Shikhandini, a female character in the Mahabharata.

in_marathi.name: Chhavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chhavi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'chhavana' which means 'to adorn'. This name is bestowed upon a girl as a symbol of grace, beauty, and adornment. In Hindu mythology, Chhavi is the name of the goddess of prosperity and good fortune, who is believed to bring wealth, happiness, and success to her devotees.
